newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end up as blue chips gain.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end up as blue chips gain.

text.p: Despite profit-taking on a large number of shares the Dhaka stocks closed up on gains by blue chip shares, mostly in engineering, parmaceutical and cement sectors, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index rose 17.5 points or 1.58 percent at 1,119.87 on a turnover of 79.5 million taka. Losers led gainers by 67 to 62. Brokers said investors booked profit on financial and textile shares.
Singer Bangladesh rose 147.31 taka to 6,736.41, Chittagong Cement gained 154.94 to 1,704.29 and Monno Fabrics lost 11.23 to 129.39.
